positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Led a full-stack engineering team spanning frontend, Go backend, and embedded QA within Fleet’s device management platform.

Owned Fleet’s vulnerability management domain and large-scale data ingestion pipelines powering software inventory and exposure reporting across 1M+ managed devices.

Delivered 230+ production changes in under a year, including 25+ major features and 200+ reliability and performance improvements.

Focused on clarifying ownership boundaries, reducing operational friction, and scaling systems and team execution as Fleet grew.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend Go engineer working across Fleet’s server and agent products.

Designed and optimized distributed services using Go, MySQL, and Redis, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and data correctness across large device fleets.

Worked on vulnerability detection, large-scale query and policy execution, and extending device management capabilities across Linux, Windows, and macOS.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: Managed distributed engineering teams (up to 11 developers across 8 states). Led the backend/agent group delivering Go microservices and deploying agent software to 1M+ devices worldwide, and directed a full-stack team building streamlined user experiences in the Automox console.
